cc:Work.dc:title: Selected urllib3 warm benchmark
cc:Work.dc:description: Selected highlight: urllib3 has the largest measured warm speedup over xdist. Minimum per workload and mode among saved snapshots with the v10 reference cache keys, matching outcomes, and 12 workers for both parallel runners. Eligible snapshots: v7-v10. Cached pytest/xdist references are reused. This combines development revisions and is not an average or a benchmark of one release.
